package.name: inspire_franka_description
package.description:
The Franka FR3 and the Inspire RH56 hand composed into one description: either as two separate objects sharing a world (a bench hand beside the arm, the default) or with the hand bolted to the arm's flange.
Also carries the simulation-only ros2_control block that puts both assets into a single hardware component, which is what lets one MuJoCo world hold both.
